Practised estimating a large collection using groups of 10 as a guide.
Ananya suggested using 4 groups and separating 10 items first, with prompts.
Defined an estimate as a close guess without counting everything.

end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group to estimate a larger collection and deciding whether an estimate is close or far. Ananya later explained that an estimate is a guess made without counting everything and correctly compared 40 with 43 and 30 with 32. At home, practise by making small groups of 10 objects, estimating the total, then counting to check the estimate.
